The Settlement brings external resources and partnerships to its historic West Town campus while extending its programs, expertise, and relationships to schools, organizations, and communities throughout Chicagoland. Northwestern Settlement is unified around the vision that the people they serve will be better prepared to seize opportunities and build a foundation for greater personal success within stronger communities. Built on fundamental values and a call to nurture, educate and inspire, Northwestern Settlement is driven by collaboration with the purpose to co-create alongside community, innovating with managed risk and operating with compassion, respect and a commitment to excellence.
